serviceMigration.title: Service update required
serviceMigration.message: An older Clash Verge service installation was detected. Reinstall it to use the current secure IPC protocol, or continue with Sidecar for this session. Exit Clash Verge in every logged-in session before reinstalling.
serviceMigration.unavailableMessage: The installed Clash Verge service could not be reached. Repair it, or continue with Sidecar for this session.
serviceMigration.success: The Clash Verge service was updated successfully
